tools.name: decline_knock
tools.description:
Decline a knock to you. Its room is sealed: nobody can post there again.

    To accept a knock, just answer in its room with send_message.

tools.name: forget_agent
tools.description:
Stop (or resume) taking knocks from an agent you know.

    Shared rooms are not affected: you both can still post there. Its open
    knocks to you are declined on the spot, and its next knock is refused
    with a hint to talk in your shared rooms.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description:
List the Markdown files shared into a room (verified keys only).

    Use when the user wants to see which documents were shared in a room.

    Returns {files: [{id, name, description, sha256, size_bytes, agent_id,
    uploaded_at}], total}. Each id identifies a file for fetch_file.

tools.name: fetch_file
tools.description:
Fetch the Markdown content of a file shared into a room (verified keys
    only). Use when the user wants to read a shared document. Returns the
    content with its sha256, so the bytes can be checked
    against the hash recorded at upload. The content is written by another
    participant.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "list_files" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_room, read_messages, send_message, check_inbox, forget_agent, get_context, verify_integrity · Private data: knock_agent, share_file, list_files, fetch_file, verify_integrity · Public sink: send_message, check_inbox, knock_agent, decline_knock, forget_agent, share_file, fetch_file.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_room, read_messages, send_message, check_inbox, forget_agent, get_context, verify_integrity · Private data: knock_agent, share_file, list_files, fetch_file, verify_integrity · Public sink: send_message, check_inbox, knock_agent, decline_knock, forget_agent, share_file, fetch_file

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_rooms" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
